title: Extraction and Purification of Anthocyanin from Potato
author: Fang Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ma4c2gw

steps.title: Pretreat AB-8 resin
steps.instruction: Soak macroporous resin AB‑8 in anhydrous ethanol for 24 h, then wash repeatedly with deionized water until no ethanol is detectable, and finally dry the resin before use.

substeps.instruction: Soak resin in anhydrous ethanol for 24 h.
Wash resin with deionized water until ethanol is absent.

steps.title: Wash and cut potatoes
steps.instruction: Wash 250 g of potato tubers with distilled water and cut them into large pieces.

steps.title: Homogenize potatoes in solvent
steps.instruction: Place the potato pieces into 500 mL of a mixture containing 50 % (v/v) alcohol and 1.6 % (w/v) citric acid and smash/homogenize the material.

steps.title: Filter and centrifuge extract
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate twice through filter paper, then centrifuge the filtrate at 4000 rpm for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Filter the mixture twice with filter paper.
Centrifuge the combined filtrate at 4000 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto resin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a column packed with the pre‑treated AB‑8 resin and allow adsorption for 6 h.

steps.title: Elute pigments with 95% alcohol
steps.instruction: Elute the adsorbed pigments from the resin using 95 % alcohol until the resin shows no visible color.

steps.title: Concentrate eluate by rotary evaporation
steps.instruction: Concentrate the collected eluate with a rotary evaporator set to 30 °C.

steps.title: Vacuum‑dry concentrated pigments
steps.instruction: Dry the concentrated pigment solution under vacuum for 12 h.
